dialogueInline.text: The water came. The gates closed. The trains rerouted. People still got dinner.

dialogueInline.speaker: SYSTEM
dialogueInline.text: Minor tidal flooding downtown. Route adjusted.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: Four minutes. Nobody swore. Nobody even looked up.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: Client patch verified. Human review requested.

LTS_C01_P07.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Justin Rourke
dialogueInline.text: I’m just saying, physically, I could’ve passed the rescue cert.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: You spelled tourniquet three different ways.

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: You ever notice nobody actually leaves anymore?

LTS_C01_P08.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: My parents moved three states chasing work before they were thirty.

dialogueInline.speaker: Matt Donnelly
dialogueInline.text: Some of us like it here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: Yeah, I know. That’s not helping me.

LTS_C01_P09.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Nicole Hanley
dialogueInline.text: Sector 14? Wait. That’s on my old harbor map.

LTS_C01_P12.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: Okay, apparently I charged five cables and nothing they go to.

LTS_C01_P13.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Justin Rourke
dialogueInline.text: Okay. I’m hearing there’s a casino out there.

dialogueInline.speaker: Matt Donnelly
dialogueInline.text: There is not a casino out there.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nicole Hanley
dialogueInline.text: I know it with my whole heart.

LTS_C01_P14.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Ryan Kelleher
dialogueInline.text: You tell him about the trench?

LTS_C01_P15.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Ryan Kelleher
dialogueInline.text: North crossing shifted after the storms.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: That’s not in the public model.

LTS_C01_P17.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: This is always worse than I remember.

LTS_C01_P18.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: You know checking it again doesn’t make the tide slower.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: Justin’s gonna get himself swept one night.

dialogueInline.speaker: Ryan Kelleher
dialogueInline.text: He’ll live. Then we’ll never hear the end of it.

LTS_C01_P19.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Nicole Hanley
dialogueInline.text: So that’s a lot of road for “nothing out here.”

LTS_C01_P20.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

LTS_C01_P21.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: SIGN
dialogueInline.text: SECTOR 14 / TRANSIT LOOP C / SERVICE ACCESS

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: They built way farther out than I pictured.

LTS_C01_P22.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: We can still turn around, right?

LTS_C01_P24.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: They had been calling it Tide Town before they saw it.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: From here, the name stopped sounding like a joke.

dialogueInline.speaker: WALL
dialogueInline.text: SAFE RAMP ↓ / TIDE HOLD 2H / NO SOUTH ENTRY / FUCK SOUTH ENTRY

dialogueInline.speaker: Nicole Hanley
dialogueInline.text: People have been arguing with this wall for a while.

dialogueInline.speaker: Matt Donnelly
dialogueInline.text: We’re not taking tide advice from a wall.

LTS_C02_P04.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Justin Rourke
dialogueInline.text: That looks safe if you don’t think about it.

LTS_C02_P05.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

LTS_C02_P06.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: I take back every bad thing I ever said about malls.

LTS_C02_P09.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: RUNNER
dialogueInline.text: That route was dry last week.

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: This is better than inland nightlife.

LTS_C02_P10.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: Seventeen if the wind keeps pushing this way.

dialogueInline.speaker: Justin Rourke
dialogueInline.text: I’m not wandering. I’m right here.

LTS_C02_P11.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Nicole Hanley
dialogueInline.text: You look like someone who owns a boat he can’t afford.

LTS_C02_P12.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: SIGN
dialogueInline.text: COMING SOON / HARBOR PHASE AQUARIUM DISTRICT

dialogueInline.speaker: Justin Rourke
dialogueInline.text: I’m telling you, this place rules.

LTS_C02_P14.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

LTS_C02_P15.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: That corridor shouldn’t run through retail.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nicole Hanley
dialogueInline.text: It doesn’t. Look. It feeds transit.

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: Mall, rail, apartments. They were building the whole thing at once.

LTS_C02_P16.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: DISPLAY
dialogueInline.text: HARBOR PHASE EAST / PROMISE DISTRICT / RESIDENCES OPENING SOON

dialogueInline.speaker: Justin Rourke
dialogueInline.text: They really thought people were gonna live out here.

LTS_C02_P17.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: RUNNER
dialogueInline.text: South bridge is clear if you’re heading Glass Rail.

LTS_C02_P19.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Matt Donnelly
dialogueInline.text: Yeah. Stay above the lower service ramp.

LTS_C02_P20.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: That wasn’t here when we came in.

LTS_C02_P21.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: I get why people stay up there.

LTS_C02_P22.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.text: We are absolutely going up there.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: We absolutely do not have much time.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: The mall was still behind them, lit by batteries and bad judgment.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: For the first time, the district felt occupied.

dialogueInline.text: Great. Still brought the wrong socks.

dialogueInline.speaker: Justin Rourke
dialogueInline.text: This time I actually brought climbing gear.

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: That is not the lesson from last time.

LTS_C03_P03.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: This is where I almost died.

dialogueInline.speaker: MARKS
dialogueInline.text: THE LIP / EAST CUT / BATTERY STAIRS / SOFT FLOOR — DO NOT TRUST

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: People will name anything out here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Ryan Kelleher
dialogueInline.text: It’s people getting lost and leaving notes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: A lot of people doing it doesn’t make it safe.

dialogueInline.speaker: Justin Rourke
dialogueInline.text: Which one is the stupid climb?

dialogueInline.speaker: Matt Donnelly
dialogueInline.text: South Teeth. And we’re not doing it.

LTS_C03_P07.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Matt Donnelly
dialogueInline.text: Upper deck is. Avoid west corner.

LTS_C03_P08.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: How many people can stand on that roof?

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: That’s not how load limits work.

dialogueInline.speaker: Ryan Kelleher
dialogueInline.text: We don’t stay past the turn.

LTS_C03_P09.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: This place has better healthcare than inland.

LTS_C03_P10.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.text: Nobody had a permit. Nobody had a schedule.

LTS_C03_P11.dialogueSource: Low Tide Signal creative writing pass

dialogueInline.text: Okay. This is actually kind of great.

dialogueInline.speaker: Justin Rourke

dialogueInline.text: Since when do we care about easy?

dialogueInline.text: The first time, leaving had felt like survival.
